chapters.title: A Night Without Darkness
chapters.synopsis: Unbelievers set a day to execute the believers if Samuel's sign does not come. Nephi cries to the Lord all day and hears that the sign comes that very night. The sun sets, no darkness falls, a new star appears, and Christ is born across the sea.

segments.speaker: mormon
segments.note: Believers face death if the sign fails

segments.speaker: the-lord
segments.note: Lift up your head; the sign comes tonight

segments.speaker: mormon
segments.note: Night without darkness; a new star

chapters.title: Forgetting the Signs
chapters.synopsis: Within a few years the people begin explaining away the great signs they saw, and wickedness returns. Converted Lamanites unite with the Nephites against the swelling Gadianton robbers. The reckoning of time is changed to date from the coming of Christ.

segments.speaker: mormon
segments.note: Signs forgotten; robbers grow strong

chapters.title: Giddianhi's Epistle of Threats
chapters.synopsis: The robber chief Giddianhi writes to governor Lachoneus, flattering him and demanding total surrender. Lachoneus refuses, gathers the people into one place with years of provisions, and appoints the prophet-general Gidgiddoni. The people repent and prepare rather than beg the Lord to excuse an attack.

segments.speaker: mormon
segments.note: Lachoneus receives an epistle

segments.speaker: giddianhi
segments.note: Surrender or be destroyed

segments.speaker: mormon
segments.note: Lachoneus gathers and fortifies the people

chapters.title: The Robbers Besiege and Fall
chapters.synopsis: The Gadianton armies, ghastly in lamb-skin and blood, attack the gathered Nephites and suffer the greatest slaughter since Lehi left Jerusalem. Siege fails because the robbers cannot live off an emptied land. Giddianhi is slain, his successor Zemnarihah is hanged, and the people shout praises to God.

segments.speaker: mormon
segments.note: Siege defeated; the people praise God

chapters.title: Mormon Names Himself
chapters.synopsis: The Nephites repent, break up the robber bands, and preach to their prisoners. Mormon steps forward as the record's maker, a disciple of Jesus Christ named after the land of his father's covenant waters. He testifies that the scattered seed of Jacob will surely be gathered again.

segments.speaker: mormon
segments.note: Peace restored; Mormon introduces himself

chapters.title: Prosperity Breeds Class and Corruption
chapters.synopsis: Rebuilt cities and open trade bring wealth, and within a few years the people fracture into ranks by riches and learning. Corrupt judges and lawyers secretly execute the prophets who testify of Christ. Kindreds and friends of the judges covenant to destroy the government itself.

segments.speaker: mormon
segments.note: Pride divides the people; prophets are slain

chapters.title: Tribes, a Murdered Judge, and Miracles
chapters.synopsis: The chief judge is murdered, the government collapses, and the people split into tribes led by family and friendship. A secret band even anoints a king, Jacob, who flees north with his followers. Through it all Nephi ministers with power, raising his brother from the dead, yet few repent.

segments.speaker: mormon
segments.note: Government falls; Nephi ministers with power

chapters.title: Three Hours That Changed the Land
chapters.synopsis: In the thirty-fourth year a great storm, earthquakes, and fire destroy city after city in about three hours. Zarahemla burns, Moroni sinks into the sea, and Moronihah is buried under a mountain. Then a thick vapor of darkness settles for three days, and the survivors' mourning fills the night.

segments.speaker: mormon
segments.note: Destruction fulfills Samuel's prophecy

chapters.title: A Voice in the Darkness
chapters.synopsis: Through the three days of darkness the voice of Jesus Christ recounts the destroyed cities and why they fell. He declares the law of Moses fulfilled in him and asks for a broken heart and contrite spirit instead of burnt offerings. He invites all survivors to come unto him and be healed.

segments.speaker: mormon
segments.note: A voice is heard across the land

segments.speaker: jesus-christ
segments.note: Christ speaks in the darkness; come unto me

chapters.title: As a Hen Gathers Her Chickens
chapters.synopsis: After hours of stunned silence the voice comes again, mourning how often the Lord would have gathered Israel as a hen gathers her chickens. The darkness lifts, the earth quiets, and the mourning turns to joy. Mormon notes that it was the more righteous who were spared to receive the risen Christ.

segments.speaker: mormon
segments.note: Silence for many hours

segments.speaker: jesus-christ
segments.note: How oft would I have gathered you

segments.speaker: mormon
segments.note: Darkness lifts; the spared await the Savior

chapters.title: The Risen Christ Descends
chapters.synopsis: A multitude at the temple in Bountiful hears a piercing yet mild voice, and the third time understands the Father introducing his Beloved Son. Jesus Christ descends in a white robe, and every person feels the wounds in his hands and side. He gives Nephi and others power to baptize and declares his doctrine: faith, repentance, and baptism, without disputation.

segments.speaker: mormon
segments.note: A voice at the temple, thrice heard

segments.speaker: god-the-father
segments.note: Behold my Beloved Son; hear ye him

segments.speaker: mormon
segments.note: A Man in white descends

segments.speaker: jesus-christ
segments.note: Christ's witness, wounds, and doctrine

chapters.title: The Sermon at the Temple Begins
chapters.synopsis: Jesus calls twelve disciples and delivers to the multitude the sermon he gave in Galilee, opening with the Beatitudes. He declares himself the giver and fulfiller of the law and raises the standard from not sinning to not even desiring sin. He closes with the invitation to be perfect, even as he and the Father.

segments.speaker: mormon
segments.note: Twelve are called and commissioned

segments.speaker: jesus-christ
segments.note: Beatitudes and the higher law

chapters.title: Treasures in Heaven
chapters.synopsis: Jesus teaches that alms, prayer, and fasting should be done for the Father who sees in secret, not for human applause, and he gives the Lord's Prayer as a pattern. No one can serve both God and mammon. Turning to the twelve, he tells them to take no thought for food or clothing, for the Father knows their needs.

segments.speaker: jesus-christ
segments.note: Secret devotion; lay up heavenly treasure

segments.speaker: jesus-christ
segments.note: Take no thought; seek first the kingdom

chapters.title: The Rock and the Sand
chapters.synopsis: Jesus warns against hypocritical judging and teaches that asking, seeking, and knocking bring the Father's good gifts. False prophets are known by their fruits, and saying Lord, Lord is no substitute for doing the Father's will. He closes the sermon with the wise man who built his house upon a rock.

segments.speaker: jesus-christ
segments.note: Ask, seek, knock; build on the rock

chapters.title: Other Sheep of the Fold
chapters.synopsis: Jesus declares that the law of Moses is fulfilled in him, for he is the law and the light. He tells the twelve that the Nephites are the other sheep of whom he spoke at Jerusalem, kept hidden because of the Jews' unbelief. The scattered branches of Israel remain known to the Father.

segments.speaker: mormon
segments.note: Jesus perceives their questions

segments.speaker: jesus-christ
segments.note: The law is fulfilled in me

segments.speaker: jesus-christ
segments.note: Ye are my other sheep

chapters.title: Still Other Sheep, and the Gentiles
chapters.synopsis: Jesus reveals yet other lost tribes he must visit, whom neither Jews nor Nephites know. He prophesies that the Gentiles will carry the gospel to the remnant of Israel, then warns the Gentiles against pride and hypocrisy in the last days. Isaiah's promise stands: the Lord will bare his arm and gather his people.

segments.speaker: jesus-christ
segments.note: Lost tribes; warning to latter-day Gentiles

chapters.title: He Healed Them Every One
chapters.synopsis: Seeing the multitude too weak to grasp all his words, Jesus tells them to ponder and prepare for tomorrow, then cannot bear to leave. He heals every sick and afflicted person brought to him, prays words too great to be written, and blesses the children one by one. Angels descend in fire and minister to the little ones.

segments.speaker: jesus-christ
segments.note: Ponder my words; I come again tomorrow

segments.speaker: mormon
segments.note: Healings, unspeakable prayer, children blessed

chapters.title: Bread, Wine, and a Standing Invitation
chapters.synopsis: Jesus institutes the sacrament of bread and wine as a remembrance of his body and blood, promising his Spirit to those who partake worthily. He commands the people to pray always in his name and to keep meeting together, turning no one away. Before ascending, he gives the twelve power to bestow the Holy Ghost.

segments.speaker: mormon
segments.note: Bread and wine are brought

segments.speaker: jesus-christ
segments.note: The sacrament given; pray always

segments.speaker: jesus-christ
segments.note: Instructions for the church's meetings

segments.speaker: mormon
segments.note: The Holy Ghost promised; Jesus ascends

chapters.title: Prayer That Words Cannot Hold
chapters.synopsis: Word spreads all night, and a greater multitude gathers as the twelve teach and are baptized, receiving the Holy Ghost and fire. Jesus returns and prays to the Father in words so marvelous they cannot be written. The disciples' faces shine white as his own as he prays for their purification and unity.

segments.speaker: mormon
segments.note: The twelve baptized; fire encircles them

segments.speaker: jesus-christ
segments.note: Jesus prays for his disciples

segments.speaker: mormon
segments.note: The disciples shine as they pray

segments.speaker: jesus-christ
segments.note: Prayer for purification and oneness

segments.speaker: mormon
segments.note: No tongue can speak such prayer

chapters.title: Miraculous Bread and Covenant Promises
chapters.synopsis: Jesus miraculously provides bread and wine and administers the sacrament again. He unfolds the covenant: the remnant of Jacob will be gathered, the New Jerusalem established, and Isaiah's watchmen will sing as the Lord bares his holy arm before all nations. The people at Bountiful are children of the covenant.

segments.speaker: mormon
segments.note: Sacrament provided miraculously

segments.speaker: jesus-christ
segments.note: Covenant promises to the remnant of Jacob

chapters.title: A Sign and a Marvelous Work
chapters.synopsis: Jesus gives a sign: when these words come forth to the Gentiles in the latter days, the gathering of Israel has begun. A great and marvelous work will divide those who believe from those who harden their hearts. The Gentiles who repent will be numbered with the covenant people and help build the New Jerusalem.

segments.speaker: jesus-christ
segments.note: The latter-day sign and marvelous work

chapters.title: Enlarge the Place of Thy Tent
chapters.synopsis: Jesus quotes Isaiah's song to the barren woman: Israel will stretch her tent, forget her shame, and gather her scattered children. The Lord's kindness will not depart, as sure as his oath after the waters of Noah. No weapon formed against the covenant people will prosper.

segments.speaker: isaiah
segments.note: Isaiah 54, quoted by the Savior

chapters.title: Search the Prophets Diligently
chapters.synopsis: Jesus commands the people to search Isaiah and all the prophets, for all things he spake have been and will be fulfilled. Reviewing their records, he finds Samuel's prophecy of the saints who rose from the dead left unwritten and has it added. He then expounds all the scriptures in one.

segments.speaker: jesus-christ
segments.note: Great are the words of Isaiah

segments.speaker: mormon
segments.note: Jesus corrects and expounds the records

chapters.title: The Refiner's Fire
chapters.synopsis: At the Savior's command the people record Malachi's words from the Father. The Lord will come suddenly to his temple, sitting as a refiner and purifier of silver. He asks whether a man will rob God, promising open windows of heaven to those who bring their tithes into the storehouse.

segments.speaker: malachi
segments.note: Malachi 3, quoted by the Savior

chapters.title: Elijah Before the Great Day
chapters.synopsis: Malachi's prophecy continues: the proud will burn as stubble, but the Sun of Righteousness will rise with healing for those who fear the Lord. Elijah the prophet will return before the great and dreadful day. He will turn the hearts of fathers and children to each other, lest the earth be smitten with a curse.

segments.speaker: malachi
segments.note: Malachi 4, quoted by the Savior

chapters.title: Not Even a Hundredth Part
chapters.synopsis: Jesus expounds all things from the beginning to the end of the earth, and even the children speak unutterable things. Mormon explains he may write only a lesser part of what was taught, to try the people's faith before greater things are revealed. The people share all things common and do all that Jesus commanded.

segments.speaker: mormon
segments.note: A lesser part written, to try faith

chapters.title: This Is My Gospel
chapters.synopsis: Appearing to the twelve as they fast and pray, Jesus names his church: it must be called in his name and built upon his gospel. He defines that gospel plainly, from his atoning sacrifice to the final judgment, and commands the disciples to be even as he is. He asks them to write all they have seen and heard.

segments.speaker: mormon
segments.note: The disciples united in prayer

segments.speaker: jesus-christ
segments.note: The church's name and Christ's gospel defined

chapters.title: Three Who Tarry
chapters.synopsis: Jesus grants nine disciples a swift entry into his kingdom at age seventy-two, and to three he gives their deeper wish: to remain on earth bringing souls to him until he comes again. The three are transfigured and cannot taste death or pain. Mormon testifies they still minister, though he was forbidden to write their names.

segments.speaker: jesus-christ
segments.note: Jesus grants each disciple's desire

segments.speaker: mormon
segments.note: The Three Nephites' transfiguration and ministry

chapters.title: When These Words Come Forth
chapters.synopsis: Mormon speaks across the centuries: when this record comes to the Gentiles, the Lord's covenant with Israel is already being fulfilled. No one should spurn the doings of the Lord or deny his revelations and gifts. Wo to those who hiss at the Jews or at the remnant, for the covenant Lord remembers his people.

segments.speaker: mormon
segments.note: Mormon warns latter-day doubters

chapters.title: Turn, All Ye Gentiles
chapters.synopsis: In two verses Mormon delivers the words Jesus commanded him to write. The Gentiles of the last days are called to turn from their wickedness, lyings, deceits, and priestcrafts. They are invited to repent, be baptized, and be numbered among the house of Israel.

segments.speaker: mormon
segments.note: Mormon addresses the future Gentiles
